nodes.title: Python stdlib collection trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is collection
candidate path is one of src/collection_tools.py
starter function matches one of chunked_list, dedupe_preserve_order, flatten_one_level, rotate, windowed
avoid_when: diagnostic only for shared failures: py_v1_chunked_list

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/collection_tools.py with chunked_list(items, size). Return a list of list chunks of length size. Include a final shorter chunk. Raise ValueError when size is not positive. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with dedupe_preserve_order(items). Return a list with duplicate items removed while preserving first-seen order. Items are hashable. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with flatten_one_level(items). Flatten one nesting level from an iterable of iterables. Strings should be treated as scalar values, not expanded into characters. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with rotate(items, amount). Return a new list rotated left by amount positions. Negative amount rotates right. Empty input returns an empty list. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with windowed(items, size). Return a list of tuples representing sliding windows of length size. Raise ValueError when size is not positive. If size is larger than the input, return an empty list. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib data trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is data
candidate path is one of src/data_tools.py
starter function matches one of csv_to_dicts, dicts_to_csv, flatten_dict, json_get_path, json_set_path
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_dicts_to_csv, py_v1_json_set_path

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/data_tools.py with csv_to_dicts(text). Parse CSV text with a header row into a list of dicts using Python's csv module. Preserve values as strings. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/data_tools.py with dicts_to_csv(rows, fieldnames). Serialize rows to CSV text using the given fieldnames and lineterminator '\n'. Include the header row. Missing values should serialize as empty strings. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/data_tools.py with flatten_dict(data, sep='.'). Flatten nested dictionaries into a single dict with joined keys. Non-dict values are leaves. Preserve insertion traversal order. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/data_tools.py with json_get_path(data, path, default=None). Return a nested value from dict/list data using a dot-separated path. Numeric path parts index lists. Return default if any part is missing or invalid. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/data_tools.py with json_set_path(data, path, value). Return a deep-copied dict with value assigned at a dot-separated object path. Create missing dicts as needed. Do not mutate the input. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib date trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is date
candidate path is one of src/date_tools.py
starter function matches one of business_days_between, days_between, format_iso_date, month_range, parse_date_parts
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_days_between

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/date_tools.py with business_days_between(start, end). Return the number of weekdays from start inclusive to end exclusive. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD. If end is before start, return the negative count in the reverse direction. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/date_tools.py with days_between(start, end). Parse start and end as ISO dates YYYY-MM-DD and return the integer day difference end - start. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/date_tools.py with format_iso_date(parts). parts is a dict with year, month, and day integers. Return YYYY-MM-DD with zero padding. Let invalid values raise naturally. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/date_tools.py with month_range(year, month). Return the first and last ISO date strings for the given year and month. Raise ValueError for invalid month. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/date_tools.py with parse_date_parts(value). Parse an ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD and return a dict with year, month, and day integers. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib graph trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is graph
candidate path is one of src/graph_tools.py
starter function matches one of dependency_order, has_cycle_directed, reachable_nodes, reverse_adjacency, shortest_path_unweighted
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_dependency_order

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/graph_tools.py with dependency_order(dependencies). dependencies maps an item to the items it depends on. Return a deterministic list where dependencies appear before dependents. Choose lexicographically smallest available item first. Raise ValueError on cycles. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/graph_tools.py with has_cycle_directed(graph). Return True if a directed graph mapping nodes to neighbors has a cycle. Include neighbor-only nodes. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/graph_tools.py with reachable_nodes(graph, start). graph maps nodes to iterable neighbors. Return a sorted list of all nodes reachable from start, including start. Missing start has no outgoing neighbors. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/graph_tools.py with reverse_adjacency(graph). Return a dict where each node maps to the sorted list of incoming neighbors from the input adjacency mapping. Include nodes that only appear as neighbors. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/graph_tools.py with shortest_path_unweighted(graph, start, goal). Return the shortest path as a list from start to goal in an unweighted directed graph mapping nodes to neighbor lists. Return None if goal is unreachable. Preserve neighbor order when ties exist. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib math trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is math
candidate path is one of src/math_tools.py
starter function matches one of clamp_numbers, histogram_bins, median, moving_average, percent_change

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/math_tools.py with clamp_numbers(values, low, high). Return a list where each number is clamped into the inclusive range [low, high]. Raise ValueError if low > high. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/math_tools.py with histogram_bins(values, bin_size). Return a dict mapping each floor bin start to a count. For bin_size 10, values 0..9 map to 0 and 10..19 map to 10. Raise ValueError when bin_size <= 0. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/math_tools.py with median(values). Return the median of a non-empty numeric iterable. For even counts, return the average of the two middle values. Raise ValueError for empty input. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/math_tools.py with moving_average(values, size). Return a list of moving averages over consecutive windows of length size. Raise ValueError when size is not positive. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/math_tools.py with percent_change(old, new). Return percentage change from old to new as (new - old) / old * 100. Raise ValueError when old is zero. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib parse trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is parse
candidate path is one of src/parse_tools.py
starter function matches one of parse_bool, parse_env_lines, parse_query_string, parse_semver, parse_size_bytes
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_parse_env_lines, py_v1_parse_semver
diagnostic only for shared failures: py_v1_parse_size_bytes

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_bool(value). Parse common boolean strings. Return True for true, yes, y, 1, on. Return False for false, no, n, 0, off. Matching is case-insensitive after stripping. Raise ValueError otherwise. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_env_lines(text). Parse .env-style lines into a dict. Ignore blank lines and lines starting with #. Split on the first equals sign. Strip surrounding whitespace from keys and values. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_query_string(query). Parse a URL query string into a dict mapping each key to a list of decoded values. Ignore a leading ?. Use urllib.parse semantics for percent decoding and blank values. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_semver(value). Parse a semantic version string MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional leading v. Return a tuple of three integers. Reject missing parts, non-integers, or negative numbers with ValueError. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_size_bytes(value). Parse an integer size string with optional binary unit suffix B, KB, MB, or GB. Units are case-insensitive and use powers of 1024. Reject decimals, negative numbers, and unknown units with ValueError. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib path trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is path
candidate path is one of src/path_tools.py
starter function matches one of common_prefix_path, extension_counts, is_subpath, normalize_segments, split_filename_version
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_extension_counts
diagnostic only for shared failures: py_v1_common_prefix_path, py_v1_normalize_segments, py_v1_split_filename_version

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/path_tools.py with common_prefix_path(paths). Return the common path prefix using POSIX path semantics. Return an empty string for no paths. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with extension_counts(paths). Return a dict counting lowercase file extensions from paths. Use an empty string for paths with no suffix. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with is_subpath(parent, child). Return True if child is inside parent or equal to parent after POSIX path normalization. Treat paths as absolute or relative strings. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with normalize_segments(path). Normalize dot and double-slash segments in a POSIX-style path without allowing the result to escape above root for relative paths. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with split_filename_version(name). Split names like report-v12.txt into ('report', 12, '.txt'). If no -v<number> suffix appears before the extension, return (stem, None, suffix). Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib security trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is security
candidate path is one of src/security_tools.py
starter function matches one of redact_bearer_tokens, redact_emails, redact_ipv4_last_octet, safe_filename, validate_relative_path
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_validate_relative_path

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_bearer_tokens(text). Replace Bearer followed by one non-space token with Bearer [REDACTED]. Matching is case-sensitive. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_emails(text). Replace email-like addresses with [EMAIL]. Match a simple local@domain.tld shape. Preserve all other text. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_ipv4_last_octet(text). Replace the last octet of IPv4 addresses with x. For example 192.168.1.42 becomes 192.168.1.x. Leave invalid addresses unchanged. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with safe_filename(name). Return a filesystem-safe filename: replace characters other than letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen with underscores, collapse repeated underscores, and strip leading/trailing underscores. Return 'untitled' if empty. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with validate_relative_path(path). Return True if path is a safe relative path. Reject absolute paths, empty paths, and any path containing .. segments. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

nodes.title: Python stdlib text trajectory delta skill
applies_when: task family is text
candidate path is one of src/text_tools.py
starter function matches one of count_word_frequencies, extract_hashtags, normalize_whitespace, slugify_text, strip_markdown_links
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_extract_hashtags

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/text_tools.py with count_word_frequencies(text). Return a dict mapping lowercase words to counts. Words are contiguous letters or digits. Ignore punctuation. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with extract_hashtags(text). Return lowercase hashtag names from text in first-seen order. A hashtag starts with # and then has one or more letters, digits, or underscores. Do not include the # symbol. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with normalize_whitespace(text). Collapse all whitespace runs in text to single spaces, trim leading/trailing whitespace, and return the normalized string. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with slugify_text(text). Convert text to a URL slug: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric words, separated by single hyphens. Treat any non-alphanumeric run as a separator and strip separators at the ends. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with strip_markdown_links(text). Replace Markdown inline links like [label](url) with just label. Leave other text unchanged. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.
